en: Psalms 147

p.src: 1  Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

ja: いこと。 賛美することは
en: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

ja: 147:1 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en: 147:1 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 2  The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

ja: はエルサレムを建て直し、 イスラエルの
en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
u.src: 2  The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

en: 147:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 3  He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

en: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
u.src: 3  He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

p.src: 4  He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

en: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
u.src: 4  He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

p.src: 5  Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

ja: ちておられる。 その英
en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
u.src: 5  Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

p.src: 6  The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

en: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
u.src: 6  The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

p.src: 7  Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

en: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
u.src: 7  Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

p.src: 8  who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

en: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
u.src: 8  who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

p.src: 9  He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

ja: き求めるからすのひなにも
en: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
u.src: 9  He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

p.src: 10  He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

en: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
u.src: 10  He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

p.src: 11  The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

ja: たちを喜ばれる。 その
en: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
u.src: 11  The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

p.src: 12  Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

ja: をほめたたえよ。 シオンよ、あなたの
en: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
u.src: 12  Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

p.src: 13  For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

ja: くし、 あなたの内にいる
en: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.
u.src: 13  For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

p.src: 14  He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

en: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.
u.src: 14  He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

p.src: 15  He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

en: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
u.src: 15  He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

p.src: 16  He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

ja: のように霜をまかれる。
en: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
u.src: 16  He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

p.src: 17  He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

ja: 小石のように、ひょうを
げ落とされる。 誰がその
en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
u.src: 17  He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

p.src: 18  He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

en: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
u.src: 18  He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

p.src: 19  He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

ja: し、 掟と定めをイスラエルに
en: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
u.src: 19  He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

p.src: 20  He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

ja: にも、このようにはされなかった。
en: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 20  He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

en: 147:20 Hebrew: יה Yah
